name: JavaScript
description: JavaScript is the core language of the web and a strong tool for scripting and backend development. This track covers modern syntax, async flows, and a mini project.

snippets.title: Set Up a JavaScript Playground
snippets.codeDes: Create a simple workspace for running modern JavaScript in Node.js.
snippets.code:
mkdir js-playground
cd js-playground
npm init -y
npm pkg set type=module
node -v

snippets.title: Objects, Destructuring, and Template Strings
snippets.codeDes: Use concise syntax to write cleaner, more readable data transforms.

snippets.title: Array map/filter/reduce Pattern
snippets.codeDes: Practice the three most common immutable operations in app code.

snippets.title: Async/Await with Error Handling
snippets.codeDes: Wrap async network calls in try/catch and return predictable values.

snippets.title: Reusable Debounce Utility
snippets.codeDes: Debounce helps reduce expensive work on rapid input events.

snippets.title: Mini Project: Expense Tracker Structure
snippets.codeDes: Small project idea: track expenses from the terminal with JSON persistence.
snippets.code:
expense-tracker/
  src/
    commands/addExpense.js
    commands/listExpenses.js
    storage.js
    index.js
  data/expenses.json

snippets.title: Mini Project: JSON Storage Module (src/storage.js)
snippets.codeDes: Keep file I/O in one module so command handlers stay focused.

snippets.title: Mini Project: Add Expense Command (src/commands/addExpense.js)
snippets.codeDes: Each command should validate input, then update storage.

snippets.title: Mini Project: CLI Entrypoint (src/index.js)
snippets.codeDes: Route command-line arguments to feature modules.

snippets.title: Run the Expense Tracker
snippets.codeDes: Use simple scripts while practicing CLI and data persistence.
snippets.code:
node src/index.js add "Coffee" 4.5
node src/index.js add "Notebook" 9.99
node src/index.js list

snippets.title: Next Learning Upgrades
snippets.codeDes: Use these to continue beyond language basics.
snippets.code:
1. Add schema validation with zod or custom guards.
2. Add unit tests for command handlers.
3. Add CSV export support.
4. Add monthly totals and category reports.
5. Add a small browser UI on top of the same logic.
